reason: council-remediation-2026-07-20/agent-P override of prior batch-062 source-scope retrenchment. The currently linked question's marked-correct option A and rationale claim 'PD 1067 specifies streams and rivers with width less than 6 meters require a 3-meter easement' and apply it to a 3.5-meter-wide creek. This is FABRICATED. PD 1067 Article 51 sets easements by LAND CLASSIFICATION (3m urban, 20m agricultural, 40m forest), NOT by stream width. The article body of lea-plan-004-06 only states easements 'along banks and shores' without specifying a width rule. Council pass restores the verified statutory rule.

source_audit_support.source_locator: PD 1067 Article 51. Article body lea-plan-004-06 normalized.md states only that PD 1067 'sets public-use easements along banks and shores' without any width-based rule.

external_sources.citation: PD 1067 (Water Code of the Philippines), Article 51

proposed.text: A proposed residential development in an URBAN area is adjacent to a creek. Under PD 1067 (Water Code of the Philippines), Article 51, what public-use easement applies along the creek bank?

rationale.a: Correct. PD 1067 Article 51 establishes a 3-meter public-use easement along banks of rivers/streams and shores of seas/lakes in URBAN areas.
rationale.b: Wrong. 10 meters is not an Article 51 figure.
rationale.c: Wrong. 20 meters applies in AGRICULTURAL areas, not urban.
rationale.d: Wrong. 40 meters applies in FOREST areas, not urban.
rationale.correct: PD 1067 Article 51: easement of public use is 3 m in urban areas, 20 m in agricultural areas, and 40 m in forest areas. For an urban creek, the easement is 3 meters and no permanent structures may be built within it.
rationale.takeaway: PD 1067 easements are determined by LAND CLASSIFICATION (urban/agricultural/forest), NOT by stream width. The 'streams less than 6 m require 3 m' rule found in some reviewers is fabricated.

proposed.explanation: PD 1067 Article 51 uses land classification to set the easement. For urban areas (including urban creeks), the easement is 3 meters.
